newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 22 OF JANUARY 22, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 22 OF JANUARY 22, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Amendment to the notice of invitation to tender for the refund for the export of oats to all third countries except Switzerland and Liechtenstein (97/C 22/06)
Non-opposition to a notified concentration (Case No IV/M.820 - British Aerospace/Lagardere SCA) (97/C 22/05)
